text: Uncoated stainless steel in the outdoor marine atmosphere shall be limited to super duplex, 6Mo and 316L with surface roughness Ra of 0.5 micrometre or better for exposed surfaces; 304 / 304L is not permitted outdoors. Where stainless steel is used for small bore piping, tubing and instrument fittings outdoors, 316L with electropolishing or a coating shall be used, and the tubing shall be of the grade 6Mo or 2507 in the splash zone.
